title: Olympiad in Programming and Sports
titleZh: 编程与体育奥林匹克竞赛
statementMd:
There are $*n*$ students at Berland State University. Every student has two skills, each measured as a number: $*a*_{*i*}$ — the programming skill and $*b*_{*i*}$ — the sports skill.

It is announced that an Olympiad in programming and sports will be held soon. That's why Berland State University should choose two teams: one to take part in the programming track and one to take part in the sports track.

There should be exactly $*p*$ students in the programming team and exactly $*s*$ students in the sports team. A student can't be a member of both teams.

The university management considers that the strength of the university on the Olympiad is equal to the sum of two values: the programming team strength and the sports team strength. The strength of a team is the sum of skills of its members in the corresponding area, so the strength of the programming team is the sum of all $*a*_{*i*}$ and the strength of the sports team is the sum of all $*b*_{*i*}$ over corresponding team members.

Help Berland State University to compose two teams to maximize the total strength of the university on the Olympiad.

## Input

The first line contains three positive integer numbers $*n*$, $*p*$ and $*s*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 3000$, $*p* + *s* ≤ *n*$) — the number of students, the size of the programming team and the size of the sports team.

The second line contains $*n*$ positive integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 3000$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the programming skill of the $*i*$-th student.

The third line contains $*n*$ positive integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 3000$), where $*b*_{*i*}$ is the sports skill of the $*i*$-th student.

## Output

In the first line, print the the maximum strength of the university on the Olympiad. In the second line, print $*p*$ numbers — the members of the programming team. In the third line, print $*s*$ numbers — the members of the sports team.

The students are numbered from 1 to $*n*$ as they are given in the input. All numbers printed in the second and in the third lines should be distinct and can be printed in arbitrary order.

If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
伯兰德国立大学有 $*n*$ 名学生。每名学生有两项技能，每项技能均以一个数表示：$*a*_{*i*}$ — 编程技能，$*b*_{*i*}$ — 体育技能。

不久后将举办编程与体育奥林匹克竞赛。因此，伯兰德国立大学需要组建两支队伍：一支参加编程项目，另一支参加体育项目。

编程队中必须恰好有 $*p*$ 名学生，体育队中必须恰好有 $*s*$ 名学生。同一名学生不能同时属于两支队伍。

校方认为，学校在本次竞赛中的实力等于编程队实力与体育队实力之和。一支队伍的实力是其成员在对应领域的技能之和，因此，编程队实力是所有编程队成员的 $*a*_{*i*}$ 之和，体育队实力是所有体育队成员的 $*b*_{*i*}$ 之和。

请帮助伯兰德国立大学组建两支队伍，使学校在本次竞赛中的总实力最大。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个正整数 $*n*$、$*p*$ 和 $*s*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 3000$，$*p* + *s* ≤ *n*$）——学生总数、编程队规模和体育队规模。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个正整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 3000$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 名学生的编程技能。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个正整数 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 3000$），其中 $*b*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 名学生的体育技能。

## 输出格式

第一行输出学校在本次竞赛中的最大实力。

第二行输出 $*p*$ 个数，表示编程队成员。

第三行输出 $*s*$ 个数，表示体育队成员。

学生按照其在输入中的顺序从 1 到 $*n*$ 编号。第二行和第三行输出的所有数字必须互不相同，且可以按任意顺序输出。

如果有多种方案，输出其中任意一种即可。
